name: Imbissstube Charlies
kurzbeschreibung:
**Charlie’s Snack Bar in Tirol** – where hearty Austrian flavors meet fresh, quick bites. Just a stone’s throw from the lively streets of **Innsbruck**, this cozy spot serves up classic **Tiroler** specialties with a modern twist. Savor crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** torn into golden shreds, piled high with jam and powdered sugar, or dig into a juicy **Wiener Würstchen** with mustard and fresh bread. For the adventurous, try their **Käseknödel**—creamy dumplings swimming in rich broth—paired with a frothy **Tiroler Bier**. The menu also features fresh salads, hearty sandwiches, and sweet treats like **Apfelstrudel** or **Topfenstrudel**, all made with love and local ingredients. Whether you’re fueling up for a hike in the **Zillertal** or just craving a taste of **Tirol**, Charlie’s is your go-to for authentic, satisfying bites. Pro Tip: Don’t leave without trying their **Kaffee mit Schlag**—the perfect pick-me-up after a day exploring **Nordkette** or wandering through **Altstadt Innsbruck**!
